description: Costed furniture plan. Start = free (CC0/CC-BY), owned packs, or build-to-measurement. Upgrade = optional paid, higher fidelity. Companion to docs/furniture-sourcing.md.

licence_rules.commit_ok: CC0 and CC-BY (add ATTRIBUTION entry) and our own builds only
licence_rules.gitignore: owned Asset Store packs, CGTrader Royalty Free (no AI), Sketchfab Standard/Free Standard, TurboSquid Standard

fidelity_scale: 1 = wrong type, 2 = right type wrong style, 3 = right style with visible differences, 4 = close (retint/rescale), 5 = matches the film

start_plan.note: every item has a free, owned or build option; nothing must be bought

hero_upgrades_only.includes: hero items whose worth_it is yes: poinsettias (F1, also covers H1), ficus, Baldwin piano, Christmas tree, Chippendale chairs (also covers F6)

everything_upgraded.note: every listed paid upgrade on in-plan items, even ones judged not worth it (excludes the L1G grand and editorial items); TurboSquid china cabinet price unknown, not counted
